title: Police Academy
about: A bunch of misfits sign up for the police academy.
cue: Serve the mains when the cadets end up at the Blue Oyster bar.
faces: Serve the mains when the cadets end up at the Blue Oyster bar.

Fackler's apple starts a riot, so eat inHow to make it150g cornmeal100g plain flour2 tbsp caster sugar2 tsp baking powder250ml buttermilk2 eggs60g butter, melted, for the batter20g butter, to grease the pan40g butter, to serveGrease a cast iron pan with the butter and heat it in a 200°C oven.Whisk the cornmeal, plain flour, caster sugar and baking powder with the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter.Pour into the hot pan and bake.Serve warm with butter.Blue Oyster bar oystersFresh oysters on crushed ice with red wine vinegar and shallotHow to make it1 shallot80ml red wine vinegarcracked black pepper, to taste16 oysters, freshly shucked1 bag crushed ice2 lemonsFinely dice the shallot and mix with the vinegar and pepper for the mignonette.Shuck the oysters and lay on crushed ice.Spoon a little mignonette over each and serve with lemon wedges.Main trayMess hall meatloafBeef and pork meatloaf. Jones does the sound effectsHow to make it500g beef mince300g pork mince60g breadcrumbs1 egg1 onion1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce80ml tomato sauce1 tbsp brown sugar1kg potatoes50g butter100ml milkMix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg, grated onion and Worcestershire.Press into a loaf tin and glaze with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar.Bake at 180°C.Boil the potatoes while the meatloaf bakes.Rest the meatloaf, mash the potatoes with butter and milk and serve thick slices.Hightower's chicken parmigianaCrumbed chicken with tomato and cheese. Hightower was a florist once.How to make it2 large chicken breasts100g plain flour2 eggs150g panko breadcrumbs200ml vegetable oil400g tinned crushed tomatoes2 garlic cloves1 tsp dried oregano200g mozzarella, grated1kg frozen chips100g rocket1 lemon1 tbsp olive oilSimmer the tomatoes with the crushed garlic, oregano and a pinch of salt for 10 minutes until thick.Slice each breast in half through the middle and flatten. Dip in flour, then beaten egg, then panko.Bake the chips at 220°C for 25 minutes.Shallow fry the chicken in the vegetable oil for 3 minutes a side until golden.Spoon the napoli over the chicken, cover with mozzarella and grill for 5 minutes until bubbling.Dress the rocket with the olive oil and lemon and serve with the parmigiana and chips.PuddingGraduation cakeVanilla slab cake with buttercream and a blue badge, for the bravery awards.How to make it200g butter, softened, for the cake200g caster sugar4 eggs250g self-raising flour125ml milk200g butter, softened, for the icing350g icing sugar4 drops of blue food colouringHeat the oven to 175°C and line a slab tin. Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour and milk.Bake.Cool the cake completely.Beat the butter with the icing sugar and tint blue.Spread on the cake.Pipe a badge and the word Graduates in blue.DrinksBlue Oyster blue lagoonVodka, blue curaçao and lemon juice shaken and served over iceHow to make it1 tray ice160ml vodka80ml blue curacao60ml lemon juice480ml cold lemonade1 lemon4 cocktail cherriesFill tall glasses with ice.Shake the vodka, curacao and lemon juice with ice and strain into the glasses.Top with lemonade, stir once and garnish with a lemon wheel and a cherry.
